content.text:
good morning — hope you've got something warm in your hand.

mira's 18-month vaccines are coming up in about two weeks, so if you haven't already rung the pediatric office to lock in a slot, now's a good time. at this stage she may also start stringing two words together — things like "more milk" or "bye daddy" — so it's worth noticing and celebrating those little combinations when they pop up. theo is doing his own thing this week: at his stage, hopping on one foot is a fun motor milestone to watch for, even if it mostly looks like enthusiastic wobbling right now.

on the local front, the community pool has a drop-in parent-and-tot swim this saturday — low-key, no sign-up stress, and a good fit for a toddler on a summer morning if the timing works for your family.
